data.name: Three Kingdoms Stratagems
data.detailed_description:
Provisions Are Heaven, Life and Death on a Thread

Provisions move before troops. Here, grain is far more than a number — it is the lifeline that can decide an entire campaign. Every soldier and every warhorse consumes supplies in real time, and you must personally plan the routes of your supply convoys, guarding them fiercely against enemy interception. Once your supply lines are cut and granaries run empty, your army will rapidly starve: morale collapses, stamina drains, soldiers begin disobeying orders and fleeing, and an elite force can disintegrate in an instant. You must personally oversee grain allocation, establish military farms, plunder enemy storehouses, and even consider “foraging off the enemy” in desperate straits — the most brutal yet most authentic way to keep your army alive. This unforgiving logistics system forces every commander to calculate every last grain before a campaign. Every expedition is the ultimate test of resource mastery.

A Tide of Foes, Seamless Offense and Defense

The enemy will never sit idle. They will hurl themselves at your defenses in relentless, endless waves, and AI commanders will even adjust troop compositions and shift the focus of their assault based on losses. Amid the frantic moments between defensive actions, you must direct your soldiers to hold the gates, plug breaches, and withstand wave after wave of all-out, suicidal attack. And once the city is successfully defended, the roles reverse in an instant — you can lead your rested, full-strength army out on the offensive, suppress internal rebellions, wipe out roving bandits, or even launch a long-range raid to strike enemy cities, carrying the war onto their soil and turning the tide from defense to attack.

Diverse Troops, Devious Formations

You can train distinct troop types such as spearmen, sword-and-shield infantry, archers, crossbowmen, light cavalry, and heavy cavalry. Every unit possesses its own attack, defense, movement speed, cost, and footprint on the battlefield, all governed by a complete rock-paper-scissors counter system. Before battle, you will freely drag, rotate, and position formation blocks on a grand sand table, meticulously arranging your forward barrier troops, main battle line, flanks, and reserves. From classic formations like the Fish Scale and the Crane Wing to your own irregular skirmish patterns, the choice is entirely yours. Exploit unit counter relationships and the advantage of deep positioning to disrupt the enemy’s line of advance before the clash even begins, forcing them to blunder headlong into the death trap you have designed.

Boundless Battlefields, Dynamic Warfare

Throw yourself into a fully open, dynamic battlefield. You can use complex terrain — mountains, forests, rivers, slopes, and ravines — to lay pocket ambushes or fight with your back to the water, achieving victory against overwhelming odds through formation placement and terrain advantage. On the battlefield, a dynamic weather system forces you to adapt: torrential rain slackens bowstrings, extinguishes fire arrows, and turns the ground into mud that bogs down heavy infantry; dense fog hides movements, ideal for surprise attacks but also a risk of stumbling into traps; scorching sun accelerates water consumption, and bitter winter blizzards drastically reduce the combat power of troops not outfitted for the cold. At the same time, a unique random character system generates distinctive wandering champions, bandit chieftains, reclusive geniuses, and even hidden legendary strategists of the enemy faction. They may suddenly charge into the fray or defect in the heat of battle, filling every siege and field engagement with unpredictable variables.

Impregnable Fortress – Building Defense in Depth

Defense is not a single thin wall — it is layer upon layer of progressively reinforced killing barriers. You can construct thick rammed-earth walls, later upgraded to brick-faced stone fortifications, and erect multi-story arrow towers, ballista platforms, and trebuchet emplacements atop them. Beyond the gates, you can add barbicans, iron portcullises, and pit traps, shaping a three-dimensional defensive line of “outer moat – rampart – main wall – inner partitions.” As you invest resources, you will unlock sequential trap arrays, rolling-log and rock-launching frames, and cascading cauldrons of burning oil, transforming every inch of your position into an insurmountable wall for the enemy. True siege warfare is not a contest of numbers — it is a brutal war of attrition and a battle of wits.

City Management, Steady Accumulation

A comprehensive city management system demands you govern your domain like a true protector of the realm. You must meticulously balance grain reserves, timber, stone, iron, and other strategic resources; expand dwellings to attract refugees, thereby broadening your tax base and recruitment pool; and plan farmlands, markets, workshops, academies, and other production and research buildings, striking a balance between civilian welfare and military industry. Population demographics, public loyalty, and corvée labor burdens all dynamically influence the stability of your city and the efficiency of conscription. Only by laying a rock-solid logistical foundation can you sustain the long, grinding war for supremacy.

Assembling Heroes, Chance and Conquest

The vast world map is scattered with rich, diverse random events: mountain bandits on the prowl, urgent distress calls from villages, fierce champions hidden in ancient temples, lost texts buried in ruins, or even an open-air scholarly gathering. Along the road, you will encounter commanders of unique skills and backgrounds. There is more than one way to bring them under your banner: inspire them with virtue and honor, entice them with wealth, promise them official rank, or, after shattering their army on the battlefield, persuade them to surrender, imprison and convert them, or even capture an enemy general and break their will through persistent psychological assault until they genuinely pledge their loyalty. Every officer holds their own personal code of loyalty and distinct preferences. Whether you can gather the realm’s finest talents into your fold depends entirely on your methods.

Unique Hero Development & Combo Mastery

You will personally forge unique, top-tier warriors in the heat of battle. Every general follows their own growth path: by slaying enemies in live combat, winning duels, and completing tactical objectives, they gradually unlock godlike combo skills such as Sweeping the Ranks, Armor-Piercing Execution, Formation Splitting, Gale Thrust, Whirlwind Dance, and Bone-Shattering Blow. These skills are never simple button presses — they interact deeply with attack rhythm, body positioning, and enemy formation. Seize a split-second opening in the chaos, chain together a smooth execution combo, and tear through the enemy line in an instant. From a fierce champion who charges ahead of the troops to a realm-expanding god of war who plucks an enemy commander’s head from among ten thousand soldiers as easily as reaching into a bag, you will witness their transformation in the grinding test of blood and iron.

Myriad Tactics, Free Skill Combinations

Every officer possesses a diverse, dedicated skill tree that covers both passive enhancements and active combat techniques. Passive abilities might permanently increase troop capacity, boost the damage of a specific unit type, or trigger a desperate last-stand state when all seems lost. Active combat skills include charge techniques, formation maneuvers, and stratagems, such as Iron Wall Defense, Blazing Arrow Formation, and Ambush Disruption. Based on your generals’ skill pools, you can freely mix and match them for different battle scenarios, crafting your own exclusive tactical school: will you have a lieutenant specialize in defense to grind the enemy down, or unleash a dual-core burst combo to obliterate the opposition? It all rests on your decision.

Blood-Soaked Growth, Ascending to a God of War

Through the crucible of countless brutal live battles, along with dedicated training fields, war academies, and combat simulation facilities, you will continuously hone your officers’ levels, base attributes, and skill proficiencies. Experience comes not only from kill counts, but also from completing high-stakes tactical assignments and scoring decisive kills on enemy commanders. You will witness them rise from mere captains leading a few hundred men, step by step, into great generals who hold entire regions, and finally into battlefield lynchpins who can shift the realm’s tides with their own strength. Their legend is written by your hand.

data.short_description: Three Kingdoms: Stratagems blends officer development, resource management, open-field defense, and real-time mass combat. As a faction commander, build defenses and lead troops against enemy hordes. Develop cities, recruit unique officers, and boost your power.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or higher, AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or higher
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (VRAM 6GB) or better, AMD Radeon RX 590 (VRAM 8GB) or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700K or higher, AMD Ryzen 7 5700X or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (VRAM 8GB) or better, AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT (VRAM 8GB) or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
